disposition_reason: Per-unit arsenic, cadmium, lead, copper and zinc results by AAS for three units each of 20 fresh vegetables, canned vegetables, tomato paste, mushrooms, herbs and a mixed seasoning bought for military meals in North Macedonia, including canned green beans in tin.

study.design: market basket survey, three units from different manufacturers per product
study.market: purchased for the consumer basket of the Military Medical Centre Skopje, North Macedonia
study.method: nitric acid digestion with H2O2; flame AAS for Cu and Zn, hydride AAS for As, electrothermal AAS for Cd and Pb
lod: solution LODs: Cu 0.4 µg/L, Zn 0.5 µg/L, As 0.5 µg/L, Cd 0.1 µg/L, Pb 0.6 µg/L; values below marked nd
